The '''Y164 Slave Transport''' was used by the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] to transport their slaves to the new owners. It was bulky but durable. It had decent firepower, but usually was protected by [[Kaloth-style battlecruiser|''Kaloth''-style battlecruisers]].

Known ships of the class included the [[Arkanian Dawn/Legends|''Arkanian Dawn'']].
